END_SEC=$(date -d 'tomorrow 03:15' +%s)
START=${START_SEC}000
END=${END_SEC}000
CALID=$(content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*_id=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)

  content insert --uri \"content://com.android.calendar/calendars?caller_is_syncadapter=true&account_name=local_account&account_type=LOCAL\" \
    --bind \"name:s:local_account\" \
    --bind \"calendar_displayName:s:Local\" \
    --bind \"calendar_color:i:16711680\" \
    --bind \"calendar_access_level:i:700\" \
    --bind \"ownerAccount:s:local_account\" \

  CALID=$(content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/calendars --projection _id:calendar_displayName 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*_id=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n 1)
fi

  --bind \"calendar_id:i:$CALID\" \
  --bind \"title:s:Meeting with Dr. Smith\" \
  --bind \"description:s:We will discuss marketing strategies.\" \
  --bind \"dtstart:l:$START\" \
  --bind \"dtend:l:$END\" \
  --bind \"eventTimezone:s:$TZ\" \
  --bind \"hasAlarm:i:0\"
echo '---VERIFY---'
content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events \
  --projection _id:title:description:dtstart:dtend:eventTimezone:calendar_id \
  --where \"title='Meeting with Dr. Smith'\" \
